execution_rules: 执行引用固定于Run输入中的设备/路线步骤；相同模块不能合并设备。定义隔离周期无正式设备身份。
执行容量仅Device/Resource引用；Device容量id必须等于device_id，Resource必须是明确绑定的实际机位。容量ID在预留账本无歧义；不以名称/坐标/人员推断。
O只消费同一job_id且ResourceClaim.resource_id等于该execution_capacity_ref.id的实际取得区间；缺容量记录为未取得证明，不从人员忙碌推出设备占用。
等待可在Job建立前携带已知执行引用和blocked phase；纯资源等待不附猜测的设备/阶段。
phase_rules: 所有有效段为正长度半开区间，progress增量等于实际有效工作ms；等待/停工不计入，零阶段只使用原PhaseCompleted点事件。
按job_id/phase_id序记录正段，暂停恢复延续有效进度；完成端必须有同刻真实PhaseCompleted事件。
前缀/暂停/取消时截至computed_until_ms，computed_boundary不是完成；无计算边界不返回已工作区间。
部分快照截取正在进行的段为computed_boundary；恢复后的下一快照替换该临时截断段，不在原段上追加重叠历史；旧已导出评估快照不被重写。
同刻边界若完成，先完成该刻闭包并记PhaseCompleted，再形成快照；不能把已真实完成写成computed_boundary。

read_contract.query: FullResult or managed typed result file
read_contract.objects_at: same Run and confirmed time <= computed_until_ms
read_contract.events: interval null means unfiltered time but still scoped/stably paged; observer end-point events use closed point membership; duration intervals remain half-open

consumers.use: group/device identity, B effective work, W waits, O exact capacity union; no B/W/O sum shortcut
historical phase effective progress/pose; wait keeps known prior progress, no nominal duration reconstruction
readonly current Run tags and blocked historical phase
same selected Run snapshot/source/frontier/effective intervals; prefix result explicitly labelled

endpoint_rules: 所有持续区间沿用正长度半开区间；任何结束均不超过computed_until_ms。
Claim的interval_end_causes与intervals逐项同序、数量相等；phase种类必须携带历史phase_ref。
resolved表示等待条件真正解除；condition_changed表示原因或阻塞对象改变后旧段结束并另开新段，均不能以计算截断冒充。
released表示Claim真正释放；observation_end仅用于完整观察窗口的end_ms且whole_window_computed=true；前缀/暂停/取消在computed_until_ms截断一律computed_boundary。
computed_boundary只用于恰好截至computed_until_ms的临时段；后续快照替换，不叠加。真实解除/释放与边界同刻时优先记录真实原因。
InitialConditions.material_allocations只接受soft_plan/hard_reserved；须按现有Item/需求引用、可用量和排他预留规则统一验证，拒绝committed及重复超额预留。
RuntimeItem拆分后每个子批保存直接split_from_ref，所有子批数量之和等于原源量；源转为transformed来源记录且不再计现有库存/空间，禁止源量和子量重复计入。取得/预留事务失败不得重复拆批；返工/报废/分配遵循调度算法。

typed_order_transport_execution_contract.compatibility: New empty arrays omit on write and absent reads empty; all previous no-choice/no-phase inputs retain their exact shape. The existing default source and whole-trip resources are unchanged.

operation_choice.selection: For each RouteStep, use exactly its operation_ref if it matches the current explicit default/inline source or an explicitly listed route_operation_refs entry. Additional entries are exact loaded Operations modules, never latest/category/name fallback.
operation_choice.physical_owner: All alternatives remain the same DeviceInstance and execution_capacity ResourceInstance; no second physical Assembly, clock, inventory or capacity.
operation_choice.per_job: Every actual Job records its one selected exact source. Material roles, ports, parameters, family, duration and readiness come from that definition and the explicit step bindings; do not merge different source trees.
operation_choice.validation: Missing/mismatched/duplicate choice, unsupported category, incompatible material/resource/unit/parameter or binding cannot execute. Existing professional producer/purpose/binding/selected-input authorization is not granted by this list; an actual professional operation must still match its real consumer gate.

transport_resources.resources: Existing resources remain held for the whole actual trip, including declared waits and return; no role name is reinterpreted into a phase.
transport_resources.loading_resources: Acquire only for actual loading; release on loading completion. Waiting does not manufacture elapsed work or cargo.
transport_resources.unloading_resources: Acquire only for actual unloading; retain cargo and whole-trip resources while unavailable/blocked, release the phase requirement on completion.
transport_resources.binding: All tables use explicit ResourceRequirement.role through SupplyRelation.resources to actual resources with exact quantity units/qualification/calendar. Roles may have arbitrary names; no loader/unloader string inference.
transport_resources.aliases: Same physical resource aliased within one trip merges overlapping declared requirements by maximum, as existing job/phase rules; independent jobs/trips still compete on aggregate actual capacity.
transport_resources.boundaries: Existing declared stage times and non-preemptive conditions remain; zero-duration stages cannot claim a closed calendar boundary. Unknown durations/resources remain named gaps, not zero/default availability.
